items.t: Automatic transmission harsh shifts or failure
items.job: Replace automatic transaxle with used or rebuilt unit
items.note: Have the codes read first; some harsh-shift faults are sensor or solenoid repairs.

items.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
items.job: Stall diagnosis, engine computer reflash or crank/cam sensor replacement

items.t: Intermittent no-start, cranks but won't fire
items.note: CarComplaints owners report an average cost of about $400.

items.t: Hard to start when cold or after sitting
items.job: Fuel pressure leak-down test and repair (injector, regulator or pump check valve)

items.t: Timing belt tensioner spring can break (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair timing belt tensioner under recall

items.t: Timing belt wears out and snaps
items.note: The V6 takes longer than the 4-cylinder.

items.t: Check engine light with code P1794 (V6)
items.job: Diagnose code P1794 and repair power supply connection

items.t: Rough running and hesitation from a failing sensor
items.job: Replace throttle position or mass air flow sensor
items.note: RepairPal lists throttle position sensor replacement at about $228-$245.

items.t: Power steering belt snaps or steering rack fails
items.job: Replace power steering belt, hose or rack-and-pinion
items.note: A belt is cheap; RepairPal lists a power steering hose at about $462-$536. A rack costs the most.

items.job: Straighten belt webbing or replace seat belt retractor

items.t: Clutch pedal sticks partway to the floor
items.job: Replace clutch master cylinder and bleed system
items.note: RepairPal lists clutch master cylinder replacement at about $287-$368.

items.t: Oil leaking into the spark plug wells
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket and spark plug tube seals
items.note: The V6 has two valve covers, which adds labor.

items.t: Won't start with the fuel cutoff light on
items.job: Reset or replace fuel cutoff (inertia) switch

items.t: Ticking engine noise and low oil pressure
items.job: Oil pressure test and oil pump replacement
items.note: The oil pump sits behind the timing belt, so a belt change is often done at the same time.

items.t: Shifter stuck in Park from a bad brake light switch

items.job: Replace power antenna mast or motor

items.t: Airbag warning label missing child seat caution (recall)
items.job: Replacement airbag caution label under recall
